content: Tal ahur fathlǝngya Faara mǝd natǝ ndaro yina ha mǝd ɓagha thlǝmad na ɓa ndeeghǝn, “Ɓoɓa, niya kyaɗo kwaman ɗi na nda a tsǝtsǝl sǝsuwadɗi ya, na tsau aten kufaya hangga.
Ənana kutǝrya ƙǝshiirha kulafayirha tǝghǝn. Nafiya ƙǝshiirha tsau nda ƙǝla nafiya nggalgha tǝ aam inabi ka kulafayirha ǝna nanda tǝghǝn.”
Tǝrgha tǝthlǝnda Faara hu sǝsǝna tǝreeghǝn a kaheerha ɗǝ. A mbǝɗi na nuneefa ni tsau aten maɓi hǝɓa natǝ chireelth thlǝmngya fa yi ˈyar Faara, tǝ tengya mǝd tǝ ɓongya kum.
Nuɗi kalɗǝ kari fa wuleren tǝ yiɓa, sakhɗa ɗafa tǝ kari tǝfasa tǝ tur ferya na chimnda fa. Nǝghǝn tsǝb tǝ wuhuleurha ha yi tǝfasa lǝlǝgɗa tǝ ǝn kaara ǝn tsanda yi kulafayirha.
A pǝmnggǝn chirethleng nda ǝnwulteena hai na sǝndǝghǝn ɓǝɓee: “Mbabila na manggǝn, man susuwaya heu, tǝ ǝn tsangya yi ƙǝshiirha.”
Naɗi nuɗi ngalɗǝ tǝ far nafiya Faara na chahal tǝ kǝm far fingya fǝrgha shedawa aten Yeeso. Ne a ƙǝlang nda nuɗi, ƙǝseegha ǝnwulteena kaan.
Ndeegha tǝthlǝnda Faara, “Kama ƙǝsna ǝnwulteena sa? Niya pǝro ˈya heu aten nuɗiya tǝ maɓidɗi nǝn a tǝra, natǝ tengya fa mǝd tǝ ɓongya kum.

Maɓidɗi nana ya ˈwaɗǝ narha tǝ yibrha fa, amma ɓalwa tǝ yibrha fa nanǝnya wa. Nǝn a thliirha sǝ ahu kwadɗi na kuɗimnggǝn ya ka mǝra ɗǝ. Nafiya na hu ƙǝshiirha chireethleng ngwa nanda thlǝm ndan hai hu ɗeleewar fǝr yibrha ka ǝna nanda ƙǝshiirha na teena a wulang kanda a nanda maɓidɗi. Nǝghǝn tǝ yibrha fa yi, nanǝnya ɓalwa tǝ yibrha fa wa, amma nǝn a nggǝr kyarhaɓa.”
Ənɗiya na midghǝnsǝ ǝnaghǝ nǝm tǝ thladwayirha. Tenggini mǝd ya mbǝd ɗangkamngya ni mǝd, nana nuɗasǝ tǝ tsaurha atenggǝn.
Na kutǝrya sǝ ƙǝm mǝd. Tuf ahur ndan fǝl nda hai, takhɗǝ tal ɓalgha hai, amma yi mǝd ɓalghǝn kula ɓarhaɓa, a ɓaɗa ɓa nǝn a tsǝrha tsǝɓaku kee.
Maɓidɗi na tǝ yibrha fa kaar, nanǝnya ɓalwa hai wa, ndǝghǝn ni kutǝra yi wuvaɗa. Nǝghǝn ahur fingya yini na mǝd ya, nǝn a ɗǝrha a mbǝd mǝrrǝghǝn ɗǝ.
Ɓonggini kum nana, kanda na kutǝrya kum ɓalgha kula thlǝ sǝsǝmnda yi kutǝryirha. Amma na nda a fǝrang kwamana kanda tǝ maɓidɗi ǝna kutǝryirha nda yi sayi ngguchit kee.
Kutǝr yini ya na numad ndan tal, na nda a fǝrang sǝsǝmndǝ ndan tǝ ngyahad ndan a maɓidɗi.

Na nda a yanda tǝ Wan Kamnda, amma na Wan Kamndǝɗi a kal kanda mu ƙǝsǝr ndǝghǝn ni Chinǝm aten chingya, tǝƙǝm kutǝra aten kutǝrya. Fingya na a thlǝmadghǝn kanda ni aah nanda, fingya na wuwura tǝ natǝ ƙǝkafek fa.
Tǝrgha ndeegha tǝthlǝnda Faara, “Aamɗi nana ya tsauna sǝsuwadɗa sǝ, kanda ni na turya, tǝ chehweeya, tǝ miiya ɗǝɗamǝn-ɗǝɗamǝn.
Ɓonggini kum nana, kanda tǝ maɓidɗi na nda a kar nad sǝsuwadɗa fa ya. Na nda a thlang ǝngya heu nanǝn tǝghǝn ha malghǝn nda tawalth, na nda a kyang thlu fadghǝn, njang ngganda ɗǝ tǝ waarha.
Ƙǝsǝr fǝrang Faara kwamana kanda ahur ndan a ǝna ˈya nda na midghǝn, nagha numad ndan tal, fǝrang sǝsǝmndǝ ndan nda maɓidɗi ka ǝna kutǝryirha nǝn ƙǝl farɗi lǝghǝd na laɓar Faara.
Nuɗi nana ya, ndǝghǝn ni wupǝri ɗi na manggǝn na a ǝna kutǝryirha aten kutǝrya ƙǝshiirha.”
